_about: Phase 2 latency backfill — captures the two PRIMARY-METRICS fields the day-by-day plan failed to land on Days 9-11.

decision_pipeline.what: DecisionPipeline.handle_proposal() — synthetic proposal through policy(auto) -> action-store put -> mock executor -> audit writes
decision_pipeline.policy_path: auto (longest path: PROPOSAL + DECISION + EXECUTION audit rows)
decision_pipeline.llm_mode: n/a (pipeline is below the planner — no LLM call here)

end_to_end.what: POST /events (context-engine) -> InMemoryEventBus -> orchestrator listener -> chain_handlers (buffer + planner + pipeline) -> audit writes -- all in-process so response time IS end-to-end latency
end_to_end.transport: InMemoryEventBus (synchronous subscriber); production Redis Pub/Sub adds extra ms
end_to_end.policy_path: auto (every event auto-executes — longest pipeline path)
